assignmentTitle: Spotify - Senior Java Engineer, VCS Infrastructure and Developer Experience
roleTitle: Senior Java Backend Developer & Software Architect
profileParagraphs: Joel is a senior Java backend developer and software architect with a master's degree in computer science from KTH and more than 14 years of experience in software development. He has deep experience with Java, Spring Boot, SQL, PostgreSQL, API design, microservices and integration-heavy distributed systems.

He has delivered business-critical backend services in banking and payments, e-health, education, culture and startup environments. His work includes microservice architecture, bank and merchant integrations, data modeling, REST APIs, CI/CD, logging, operational support and systems with high requirements for security, traceability, uptime, performance and test coverage.

Joel combines hands-on backend delivery with architecture, code review, debugging, Git-based development workflows and AI-assisted engineering practices. He quickly understands complex technical stacks and internal organizations, and contributes with clear problem solving, quality practices and knowledge sharing across teams.
